input.claim_text: On 16 February 2024 I noticed new cracks running through the brickwork and internal walls on the western side of my house. A builder has advised that the ground beneath that part of the house has subsided and the footings have moved. I have been quoted approximately $12,500 for the repairs.

input.query: Is subsidence or ground movement causing footing and wall cracking covered or excluded?

output.answer:
Based on the excerpts provided, **soil movement — including erosion, landslide, mudslide or subsidence — is excluded**, unless it is directly caused by and occurs within 72 hours of an explosion, earthquake, tsunami, storm, cyclone, rainwater or flood or flood water, combined with run-off and/or rainwater [Allianz Home PDS, page 55].

Additionally, if the footing and wall cracking results from **wear and tear** — including "cracks in walls or sagging floors due to the age of the property" — this is also separately excluded [Allianz Home PDS, page 55].

So, subsidence-related cracking would only be covered if you can show it was a direct result of one of the specified insured events (explosion, earthquake, tsunami, storm, cyclone, rainwater, or flood/flood water combined with run-off/rainwater) occurring within 72 hours of the soil movement. Otherwise, it is excluded [Allianz Home PDS, page 55].

The excerpts do not provide further detail on how "directly caused by" or the 72-hour window would be assessed in practice, so I cannot go beyond what is stated here.

turns.text:
DECISION: escalate

The claim's cause is builder-diagnosed subsidence/footing movement, which the Allianz Home PDS explicitly excludes unless directly caused by (and within 72 hours of) a specified insured event such as explosion, earthquake, tsunami, storm, cyclone, rainwater or flood combined with run-off [Allianz Home PDS, page 55]. The narrative gives no indication of any such triggering event — it simply describes gradual ground subsidence noticed over time — which directly conflicts with this exclusion. There is also a separate wear-and-tear exclusion for age-related wall cracking that may apply [Allianz Home PDS, page 55]. Because the claimed cause directly conflicts with a clear policy exclusion, and determining whether any qualifying insured event occurred within the 72-hour window requires further factual investigation, this must be escalated to a human reviewer rather than decided automatically.
